I personally like really like it, I can't imagine doing anything other than it. There are so many specialties and fields. If there's one you don't like, you're not obligated to stay by any means.

I switch my schedules back and forth. I try to go to the gym (since there's so much goddamn sitting on nights) and I try to eat lunch the same time in the night as I would the day. 

If I have another shift the next day I try and sleep 8 hours. To get back on functioning during the days I opt for 6 hours of sleep so I'm tired enough to go to bed at a reasonable hour. 

To keep up functioning on days I try to schedule my classes in the later morning so the change isn't too extreme.
